svg.title: The decoding boundary
svg.desc: Whether the claim can be checked by a machine, or only by a human
svg.text: 3 · The decoding boundary
Whether the claim can be checked by a machine, or only by a human
WITHOUT A CONCEPT SET AT YOUR END
The agent answers in free text
"The case can be processed under
the applicable rules, cf. annex 3."
The sentence is well formed. Whether it is correct can only
be decided by someone who knows the case.
One human per decision
The burden grows with usage. There is no way out.
WITH A CONCEPT SET AT YOUR END
The agent answers in your concepts
case type: CASE-04 · legal basis: §12
concept set v2-1-0 · evidence rank 2
The answer is a symbol that exists in your own
concept set. If it does not, the answer is rejected.
Routine passes, the exception moves on
The human sees only what falls outside - not everything.
WHERE THE CONCEPT SET COMES FROM
If you have one, we use yours. If you do not, we supply a working set with an agreed expiry date that you take over along the way.
The structure is ours - how a concept is defined, versioned and owned. The content is yours and stays yours.
This is where Verify connects to Custody: the concept set is versioned and signed,
and every decision carries which version it was made under.
Without a concept set, verification can only check the form. Not whether the answer is correct.
This is where the burden breaks
